thread:
amelia-sales: Regulator-backed bank (Nordica Bank) asked for an EU-only PoC package: hosting boundary diagram, KMS/BYOK flow, retention matrix, and a full subprocessor list with SCC/DPA links. They want to review with vendor-risk on Monday. Need an initial bundle by EOD today.

leo-arch: I can create a compact hosting boundary (PDF) showing eu-central-1 + eu-west-1 as allowed regions and a snippet to lock region_policy. Will note that we can pin to a single region if requested.

zoe-security: I'll add a retention/logging table: request logs 90d (tokens redacted), key-audit 1y (immutable), admin audits 2y. I'll flag any logs that include hashed IDs and how we pseudonymize.

nina-legal: I'll export the subprocessor CSV (name, role, primary-region, staff-locations, contract-ref). If any subproc has support staff outside EU, I'll include mitigation clauses and SCC status. Also will draft a short attestation: "Data processing for the scoped PoC will be restricted to EU regions listed in the hosting boundary."

deploy-bot: Uploaded artifacts -> https://files.redwood.internal/nordica-eu-poc-hosting.pdf and https://files.redwood.internal/nordica-subproc-roster-v1.csv (access: sales/legal).

amelia-sales: Great. Zoe/Leo/Nina 93 please confirm BYOK flow (customer KMS / HSM wrap) + that key usage logs can be exported to their auditor. I'll send the packet once we have those confirmations.

leo-arch: BYOK supported; sample config: region_policy.allowed = [eu-central-1]; kms.mode = "BYOK"; kms.audit_sink = "audit-logs-eu". Will include in PDF.

zoe-security: Confirmed: key-usage logs show keyID and op-type but never plaintext. We can export logs to customer collector and mark retention = 1y.

nina-legal: Attestation draft uploaded -> https://files.redwood.internal/nordica-eu-poc-attestation-draft (access: sales/legal). If Nordica insists on removing a subproc for PoC, recommend Dedicated option (VPC + private peering + BYOK).

amelia-sales: Thanks team. I'll package and send to vendor-risk Monday morning unless we get an earlier ask. :thumbsup:
